title: EFC External Research Watchlist
purpose: Track external datasets, surveys, and papers that could confirm, falsify, or constrain EFC. Source-of-truth for 'what has Claude already seen'. Agents MUST read this before searching the web so follow-up reports show only deltas.
author: Morten Magnusson

schema.key: Stable canonical ID (arXiv, DOI, or survey acronym)
schema.title: Short human-readable title
schema.url: Primary URL (arXiv abs, journal, or survey page)
schema.date_seen: ISO date when this item was first logged here
schema.date_published: ISO date of publication / data release
schema.ledger_action: Concrete change required in EFC ledgers, or 'noted' if informational

framework_taxonomy_note.purpose: v1.2 introduces canonical competing-framework entries (source_type='framework-seminal') so Symbiose graph gets explicit (:Publication:Framework)-[:COMPETES_WITH]->(:Theory{canonical:'EFC'}) nodes for every major alternative to ΛCDM and EFC. Frameworks are keyed by their seminal publication (arXiv or DOI) and positioned via recovery-condition or discriminator language — never 'ruled out' unless sealed blind test exists.
framework_taxonomy_note.language_policy: Conservative wording. Use 'EFC is positioned as', 'EFC recovery condition reduces to', 'discriminator from EFC is', 'shared mechanism with'. Never 'EFC is superior to' or 'X is wrong'.

pending_review_2026_05_01.purpose: Items identified during 2026-05-01 ledger-impact review as touching the seven existing thematic clusters (or requiring a new cluster) but not yet present in items[]. Each entry needs arXiv/DOI verification before promotion to a full items[] row. Listed here so symbiose graph and HTML rendering pipeline are aware of the pending-add backlog without prematurely materialising unverified canonical IDs.
pending_review_2026_05_01.language_policy: Same conservative wording as items[] schema. No 'confirms EFC' phrasing.

candidates.ledger_action: Add modelfree-w(z) reconstruction paper(s) to cluster 'desi_dr2_de_evolution'; flag z ~ 0.44/0.5 alignment for cross-reference in WP1 recovery-conditions table.

candidates.ledger_action: Add as second high-precision CMB-lensing entry alongside arXiv:2504.20038; promote 'theory-efclass-boltzmann-solver' gap further if the new precision exceeds 1.6%.

candidates.topic: KiDS-Legacy cosmic shear standalone entry (S8 ~ 0.815, < 1sigma vs Planck)
candidates.efc_relevance: The other arm of the bifurcated S8 picture: KiDS-Legacy converges toward CMB while DES Y6 sits 2.4-2.7sigma below. Heterogeneity is itself a signal for F4 status.
candidates.ledger_action: Promote KiDS-Legacy from being-only-cited-in-review to its own publication row; update F4 falsifier status note in EFC_Predictions.html (currently 'Monitoring 2-3sigma now') to reflect probe split.

items.title: Informational Entropic Gravity (IEG)
items.efc_relevance: Closest ontological relative published in 2026; gravity as macroscopic equilibrium of informational entropy on holographic boundaries.

items.title: The Atacama Cosmology Telescope: A Test of the Gravitational Force Law on Cosmological Scales Using the Kinematic Sunyaev-Zeldovich Effect
items.efc_relevance: kSZ pairwise-velocity test constrains g ∝ 1/r^n with n = 2.1 ± 0.3 on 30–230 Mpc (Newtonian preferred, MOND poor fit); bounds any large-scale deviation EFC's L2→L3 transition could introduce.
items.ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as blocking constraint for EFC's inter-cluster regime; require EFC L3 predictions to preserve 1/r² at 30–230 Mpc within ±0.3 in n. Cross-reference in WP3 Falsification Protocol and competitor-landscape table.

items.title: ΛCDM (Standard Model of Cosmology, Planck 2018 baseline)
items.efc_relevance: The baseline against which every cosmological framework is measured. EFC recovers ΛCDM as a limit when (i) K(ρ) → ∞, (ii) T(a) → 0, (iii) ξ ≫ 1 hold simultaneously; then μ, Σ, η → 1 and the relativistic action reduces to Einstein–Hilbert + Λ. ΛCDM is thus a special case of EFC, not a competitor to be falsified.
items.ledger_action: Register as canonical baseline framework in Symbiose graph. Link recovery conditions (WP1 Consolidation Paper DOI 31943361).

items.title: wCDM / w0waCDM (CPL parametrization, Chevallier–Polarski–Linder)
items.efc_relevance: Phenomenological w(a) = w0 + wa(1−a). EFC's L2→L3 regime transition gives an effective w(z) that maps onto the (w0, wa) plane; DESI DR2's 3.1σ preference for w0wa is directionally consistent with EFC's α = −0.14 ± 0.21. Shared signal, not EFC-exclusive.
items.ledger_action: Logged as parametric-competitor for background-sector tests. Cross-reference arXiv:2503.14738 (DESI DR2) and ledger_darkenergy_evolution_wz.

items.title: Quintessence (dynamical scalar-field dark energy)
items.efc_relevance: A canonical scalar φ with V(φ) drives late-time acceleration (w > −1 always). Competing ontology vs EFC: quintessence adds a new degree of freedom, EFC re-derives DE dynamics from entropic flow on existing geometry. Discriminator: quintessence cannot cross w = −1; EFC can if T(a) inverts sign.
items.ledger_action: Logged as competitor to EFC's L2→L3 mechanism. Compare recovery conditions in WP1.

items.title: Early Dark Energy (Poulin, Smith, Karwal, Kamionkowski)
items.efc_relevance: Pre-recombination scalar-field injection targeting H0 tension; recent pre-recombination EDE analyses (arXiv:2511.16606, 2604.13535) partially suppress the DESI DR2 w0wa preference. Directly competes with EFC for explaining both H0 and dark-sector evolution; their CMB imprints differ (EDE shifts sound horizon; EFC shifts μ–Σ slip).
items.ledger_action: Logged as competitor for H0-tension + DESI-DR2 interpretation. Required comparison in WP3 Falsification Protocol, probe-by-probe ΔAIC table.

items.title: Holographic Dark Energy (Li 2004)
items.efc_relevance: DE density ρ_de ∝ c² / (8πG L²) with holographic IR cutoff L. Ontological overlap with EFC: both derive DE from bounded information/entropy on cosmological surfaces, but HDE fixes the IR scale phenomenologically, EFC derives it from the density-stiffness K(ρ). A family of HDE variants (future horizon, Hubble radius, Ricci scalar) must be compared against EFC individually.
items.ledger_action: Logged as entropic-ontology cousin. Cross-reference Kaniadakis variant and WP1 recovery-conditions.

items.title: Kaniadakis Holographic Dark Energy (κ-entropy generalisation)
items.efc_relevance: Replaces Boltzmann–Gibbs entropy with Kaniadakis κ-entropy in the holographic DE construction. Same information-entropy family as EFC but with a different functional form for the entropy functional S[ρ]. Discriminator is the late-time growth-rate fingerprint fσ8(z) and the sign of the deviation at the matter–DE crossover.
items.ledger_action: Logged as Kaniadakis-variant cousin of HDE. Required comparison in WP1 recovery-conditions table (κ→0 should recover EFC entropic term).

items.title: Quintom Dark Energy (Feng, Wang, Li)
items.efc_relevance: Two-field construction (canonical + phantom) that crosses the w = −1 divide. DESI DR2 quintom A/B analyses (arXiv:2601.02284) are directionally compatible with EFC's L2→L3 transition — both models can produce phantom-crossing without ghost instabilities at the background level. Discriminator: EFC predicts correlated μ(a)<1 at perturbation sector, quintom does not.
items.ledger_action: Logged as phantom-crossing competitor. Cross-reference arXiv:2601.02284 and FA2 (μ sign).

items.title: Coupled Dark Energy + Dark Matter (Amendola; 2026 revival arXiv:2604.08449)
items.efc_relevance: Explicit Q-coupling in dark sector produces effective w(z) that crosses −1 and modifies DM clustering. Resurgent post-DESI-DR2 (arXiv:2604.08449). Parallel mechanism to EFC's entropic coupling: both transfer energy between components, but EFC does so via S-gradient of geometric stiffness; coupled DE/DM does so via phenomenological Q(φ, ρ).
items.ledger_action: Logged as interaction-sector competitor. Required discriminator is the clustering-rate residual on 30–100 Mpc scales.

items.title: Thawing Quintessence in Curved Background (post-DESI)
items.efc_relevance: Post-DESI-DR2 variant: canonical (non-phantom) quintessence remains viable in a spatially curved FRW background. Contradicts claims that DESI DR2 forces phantom dynamics. Relevant to EFC as a non-phantom alternative with different cosmographic signature; consistent with EFC background if Ω_k absorbs the L2→L3 residual.
items.ledger_action: Logged as 2025 non-phantom alternative. Track for Euclid-DR1-era discriminator.

items.title: MOND (Modified Newtonian Dynamics, Milgrom 1983)
items.efc_relevance: Interpolation function μ(x) with characteristic scale a0 ≈ 1.2×10⁻¹⁰ m/s² fits SPARC rotation curves without dark matter. EFC contains MOND as the low-acceleration local limit: EFC's Grid-AQUAL construction reduces to Milgrom's force law when a ≪ a0 and S-gradient saturates. Shared phenomenology at galactic scales, different ontology, different predictions at cluster scale (where MOND underpredicts, EFC predicts dense-regime return to Newtonian).
items.ledger_action: Logged as galactic-scale mechanistic relative. Cross-reference SPARC tests (ledger_galaxy_rotation_curves_sparc) and Verlinde 2016 (shared a0).

items.title: TeVeS (Tensor–Vector–Scalar gravity, Bekenstein)
items.efc_relevance: Relativistic completion of MOND with three fields (gμν, Uμ, φ). Explained galactic RC but failed CMB acoustic peaks without additional dark matter; superseded by RMOND. Positioned relative to EFC as a historical relativistic-MOND attempt — EFC achieves galactic MOND-limit without extra fields, using entropic flow on existing metric.
items.ledger_action: Logged as historical relativistic-MOND reference. Kept for recovery-condition comparison (WP1).

items.title: RMOND / Relativistic MOND (Skordis & Zlosnik)
items.efc_relevance: New RMOND action reproduces CMB acoustic peaks, BAO, and rotation curves in a single relativistic theory. Stronger competitor than TeVeS — must be compared against EFC on CMB, BAO, AND SPARC simultaneously. Discriminator: RMOND introduces two extra fields (Aμ, φ) with specific coupling; EFC uses one scalar (S) derived from entropic-flow constraint.
items.ledger_action: Logged as primary 2021+ relativistic-MOND competitor. Required benchmark in any EFC multi-probe comparison table.

items.title: f(R) Gravity (Starobinsky exponential model)
items.efc_relevance: Replaces R with f(R) in the Einstein–Hilbert action; produces effective scalar degree of freedom (scalaron). f(R) generically gives μ > 1 (gravity strengthened); EFC predicts μ < 1. This is a sharp sign-level discriminator (FA2 falsification criterion). DESI-DR2 analyses (arXiv:2504.05432) show f(R) is preferred over ΛCDM; EFC and f(R) therefore sit on opposite sides of the same data.
items.ledger_action: Logged as primary modified-gravity competitor. Already referenced in Gap Analysis §6; explicit FA2 discriminator.

items.title: DGP Braneworld Gravity (Dvali–Gabadadze–Porrati)
items.efc_relevance: 4D brane embedded in 5D bulk; gravity leaks to extra dimension at late times. Original self-accelerating branch ruled out by growth; normal branch (nDGP) survives as perturbation-sector test bed. Standard benchmark for modified-gravity μ–Σ analyses. EFC must be compared head-to-head with nDGP on weak-lensing Σ and growth fσ8.
items.ledger_action: Logged as canonical extra-dimensional competitor. Required benchmark in perturbation-sector tests (ledger_perturbationsector_valley).

items.title: Horndeski Gravity (most general second-order scalar–tensor)
items.efc_relevance: Full Horndeski Lagrangian spans all consistent second-order scalar–tensor theories. GW170817 eliminated α_T ≠ 0 branches. EFC's 135k-point numerical scan (documented in FA3 hedge) shows standard quasi-static Horndeski with α_T = 0 cannot produce μ < 1 and Σ > 1 simultaneously — an EFC signature therefore falsifies standard Horndeski-QS. Discriminator structure is well-defined and recorded.
items.ledger_action: Logged as encompassing scalar-tensor competitor class. Cross-reference FA3 and conv_hi_class_scalar_tensor_efc_falsification_test.

items.title: Galileon Gravity (Nicolis–Rattazzi–Trincherini)
items.efc_relevance: Scalar with Galilean shift-symmetry; self-accelerating cosmology, Vainshtein screening locally. Sub-class of Horndeski. Produces enhanced growth (μ > 1) — again opposite sign to EFC prediction, enabling FA2-type discriminator. Cubic galileon self-accelerating branch strongly constrained by ISW cross-correlation.
items.ledger_action: Logged as Horndeski sub-class with enhanced growth. FA2 discriminator applies.

items.title: Kinetic Gravity Braiding (KGB)
items.efc_relevance: Derivative coupling between scalar and metric kinetic terms; produces background self-acceleration without ghosts. Another Horndeski sub-class producing enhanced growth. Included for completeness of scalar-tensor benchmark set.
items.ledger_action: Logged as Horndeski sub-class benchmark.

items.title: Weyl-geometric Gravity (Harko et al., SPARC-tested)
items.efc_relevance: Uses Weyl non-metricity to produce effective acceleration at galactic scales; tested on SPARC rotation curves (arXiv:2311.16893). Alternative geometric route to MOND-like phenomenology without entropic ingredient. Competitor in the same SPARC regime where EFC k=0.415 applies.
items.ledger_action: Logged as geometric competitor on SPARC. Required head-to-head ΔAIC comparison.

items.title: Brans–Dicke Gravity (classic scalar–tensor)
items.efc_relevance: Scalar φ setting effective gravitational coupling G_eff = 1/φ, constrained by Solar-System tests to ω_BD > 40 000 (Cassini). EFC recovers Newtonian limit via K(ρ)-stiffness, not via large ω_BD. Kept as historical anchor and as member of scalar–tensor family sub-summed under Horndeski.
items.ledger_action: Logged as Horndeski ancestor. Solar-System bound is a EFC sanity check.

items.title: Massive Gravity (de Rham–Gabadadze–Tolley)
items.efc_relevance: Ghost-free massive graviton construction; cosmological viable branches tightly constrained by GW speed and tensor-mode dispersion. Distinct ontology from EFC (modifies the graviton sector) but appears in the same perturbation-sector μ–Σ tables.
items.ledger_action: Logged as graviton-mass competitor. Bounded by GW170817 constraint on c_T.

items.title: Jacobson: Einstein Equations as Equation of State
items.efc_relevance: Derives Einstein field equations from local Rindler horizon thermodynamics (Clausius relation δQ = T dS). Conceptual ancestor of every entropic gravity program including EFC. EFC inherits the assumption that geometry is thermodynamic in origin, but replaces local Rindler horizon with global entropic field S(x) on the grid.
items.ledger_action: Logged as ontological ancestor. Explicit parent-citation in WP1 recovery-conditions.

items.title: Padmanabhan: Thermodynamic Aspects of Gravity
items.efc_relevance: Systematic thermodynamic reformulation of gravitational field equations across Lanczos–Lovelock theories; gravity as elasticity of spacetime with density of degrees of freedom on holographic surfaces. Shared conceptual scaffolding with EFC. Discriminator: Padmanabhan's framework leaves matter sector intact; EFC couples entropy directly to effective density through K(ρ).
items.ledger_action: Logged as emergent-gravity programme relative. Required comparison in WP1.

items.title: Verlinde 2010: On the Origin of Gravity and the Laws of Newton (Entropic Gravity)
items.efc_relevance: Newton's law as an entropic force on holographic screens. Direct conceptual predecessor of EFC; EFC replaces the holographic screen with a dynamical entropic field S(x) on a lattice and extends to perturbation sector. Shared a0-emergence (Verlinde's a0 ∼ cH0 rediscovered in EFC).
items.ledger_action: Logged as closest direct predecessor. Explicit parent-citation in WP1 and Elevator Pitch.

items.title: Verlinde 2016: Emergent Gravity and the Dark Universe
items.efc_relevance: de Sitter volume-law entropy contribution explains dark-matter phenomenology without particle DM. Predicts a MOND-like g_D(r) profile at galactic scales. Tested against RAR (arXiv:1702.04355) and against wide-binary low-acceleration anomaly (ScienceDirect 2024). EFC and Verlinde-2016 share a0 and dark-matter-as-emergent stance; discriminator is cluster-scale behaviour (Verlinde fails, EFC predicts Newtonian return).
items.ledger_action: Logged as EFC's closest living-competitor on dark-sector phenomenology. Required head-to-head on Bullet Cluster + SPARC + cluster-dynamics.

items.title: Mass-to-Horizon Entropic Cosmology (2025)
items.efc_relevance: Entropic cosmology using mass-to-horizon entropy; preferred over ΛCDM in DESI DR2 BAO Bayes-factor comparison. Shares entropic-cosmology family membership with EFC but lacks galactic / perturbation-sector sector. Referenced already in Gap Analysis §6.
items.ledger_action: Logged as 2025 entropic-cosmology competitor. Cross-reference DESI DR2 BAO test.

items.title: Machian Gravity (SPARC rotation-curve fit, 2023)
items.efc_relevance: Machian formulation with cosmological boundary conditions fits SPARC with a characteristic acceleration. Another member of the MOND-limit family on galactic scales. Keeps EFC's competitor table complete.
items.ledger_action: Logged as SPARC-family competitor. Head-to-head ΔAIC on SPARC 175.

items.title: Conformal Cyclic Cosmology (Penrose)
items.efc_relevance: Universe as infinite sequence of aeons joined by conformal rescaling at cosmological horizons. Radically different ontology from EFC — CCC is pre-big-bang cyclic, EFC is single-aeon with internal regime transitions. CCC predicts specific CMB anomalies (Hawking points); EFC predicts μ–Σ deviations. Not directly comparable probe-by-probe but both challenge standard ΛCDM initial-conditions narrative.
items.ledger_action: Logged as alternative cosmology with orthogonal test surface. Reference only; no head-to-head foreseen.

items.title: Timescape Cosmology (Wiltshire)
items.efc_relevance: Inhomogeneous cosmology: apparent acceleration arises from backreaction of voids on light propagation, not a true cosmological constant. Competitor to every DE-based framework including EFC. Recent Pantheon+ and DES-SN5YR reanalyses revive Timescape as a viable late-time alternative. Discriminator: Timescape predicts no CMB-lensing enhancement from DE; EFC predicts specific Σ > 1 signal.
items.ledger_action: Logged as backreaction-based competitor. Required comparison in CMB-lensing tests.

items.title: Ekpyrotic / Bouncing Cosmology (Khoury, Ovrut, Steinhardt, Turok)
items.efc_relevance: Replaces inflation with slow contraction + bounce. Relevant to EFC only at the level of initial conditions / primordial power spectrum: EFC operates in the post-CMB regime and is agnostic about pre-big-bang dynamics. Kept for taxonomic completeness of alternative early-universe paradigms.
items.ledger_action: Logged as pre-CMB alternative. Reference only.

items.title: Quantized Inertia / MiHsC (McCulloch)
items.efc_relevance: Modification of inertia via Unruh radiation + Hubble horizon cutoff; predicts MOND-like a0 from first principles. Fringe-position competitor with specific wide-binary predictions (tested 2024). Kept for completeness of MOND-limit derivations — EFC derives similar a0 from S-field rather than from Unruh mechanism.
items.ledger_action: Logged as MOND-limit derivation alternative. Reference for a0 emergence.

items.title: Self-Interacting Dark Matter (Spergel & Steinhardt)
items.efc_relevance: Dark matter with non-zero self-scattering cross section σ/m ∼ 0.1–1 cm²/g addresses cusp-core, diversity, and Bullet Cluster morphology. EFC's stance: no new particle; dense-regime cluster behaviour explained by entropic return to Newtonian. SIDM and EFC are orthogonal hypotheses on the same data (Bullet, AS1063, cluster cores) — direct predictions differ.
items.ledger_action: Logged as primary particle-sector DM alternative. Tested by AS1063 JWST (2602.15940); bears on Bullet δκ test.

items.title: Fuzzy / Ultralight Axion Dark Matter (Hu, Barkana, Gruzinov)
items.efc_relevance: DM as ultralight scalar m ∼ 10⁻²² eV with de Broglie wavelength ∼ kpc; suppresses small-scale structure. Orthogonal to EFC; scope-separation note: EFC is gravity-sector, FDM is particle-sector. FDM and EFC can in principle be simultaneously true or simultaneously false.
items.ledger_action: Logged as particle-sector DM alternative. Scope-separation note in Elevator Pitch.

items.title: Superfluid Dark Matter (Khoury)
items.efc_relevance: DM undergoes BEC phase transition inside galaxies, producing MOND-like force via phonon exchange; retains CDM-like behaviour at cluster scales. One of the more sophisticated hybrids. Shares the MOND-limit galactic regime with EFC but achieves it through superfluid phonons rather than entropic field.
items.ledger_action: Logged as hybrid-regime competitor. Required comparison on galactic ↔ cluster transition.

items.title: Primordial Black Holes as Dark Matter (Carr & Hawking)
items.efc_relevance: Black holes formed in early universe as DM candidate; LIGO-Virgo detections reopened asteroid-mass window. Orthogonal to EFC; same scope-separation as FDM/SIDM.
items.ledger_action: Logged as particle-equivalent DM alternative.

items.title: Van der Waals Gravity Theory
items.efc_relevance: Jacobson-Clausius extension with non-ideal thermodynamic equation of state in the gravitational sector; effective gravitational coupling becomes density-dependent and resolves the initial-singularity. Direct ontological cousin of EFC: shared Clausius-relation derivation, shared evolving-G_eff structure that EFC realises through K(ρ)-stiffness.
items.ledger_action: Add to External Research Ledger as 2026 emergent-entropic-gravity competitor; cross-reference framework:Jacobson-1995 and framework:Padmanabhan-2009; required ontological-comparison row in WP1 recovery-conditions table.

items.title: Viability of Big Bang Nucleosynthesis in Some Generalized Horizon Entropies
items.efc_relevance: Derives BBN bounds (freeze-out temperature, helium and deuterium abundances) on the same generalized-horizon-entropy family that contains framework:MassToHorizon-2025 and EFC's L1 entropic regime; tightens the high-z floor on EFC parameter space.
items.ledger_action: Add as blocking BBN constraint to Validation Ledger; require explicit EFC L1-prediction set to satisfy BBN bounds; cross-reference framework:MassToHorizon-2025 and EFC L1→L2 transition node.

items.title: Cosmology of the interacting Tsallis holographic dark energy in f(R,T) gravity framework
items.efc_relevance: Tsallis-entropy generalisation of holographic DE inside f(R,T) gravity — a hybrid of two competitor classes already logged (HolographicDE-Li2004, KaniadakisHDE-Drepanou2021). Same generalised-entropy family as EFC's information-entropy ansatz; required head-to-head ΔAIC at background plus growth.
items.ledger_action: Logged under entropic/holographic-DE comparator family; cite in WP1 recovery-conditions table; add to competitor-landscape ΔAIC matrix.

items.title: The f(Q,T) gravity and affine EoS: observational aspects
items.efc_relevance: Modified-gravity competitor with explicit DESI BAO + Pantheon+SH0ES + Cosmic-Chronometer constraints on a linear f(Q,T)=Q+βT model with affine equation of state. Spans the same (w0, wa)-plane as EFC's L2→L3 transition; required head-to-head ΔAIC entry.
items.ledger_action: Add to WP3 competitor-landscape table; cross-reference arXiv:2503.14738 (DESI DR2) and framework:wCDM-CPL-Chevallier2001.

items.title: Impact of the Infrared Cutoff on Structure Formation in Tsallis Holographic Dark Energy
items.efc_relevance: Demonstrates that fσ8(z) growth predictions in the Tsallis-entropy holographic family depend strongly on the IR-cutoff choice (future-event horizon ≈ ΛCDM, particle horizon fails). Direct lesson for EFC: the boundary-condition / IR-completion choice in the entropic field S(x) must be argued explicitly, otherwise EFC inherits the same degeneracy.
items.ledger_action: Add to WP1 recovery-conditions table as IR-completion sensitivity warning; cross-reference EFC perturbation-sector growth predictions (FA2 / μ(a)<1) and ledger_perturbationsector_valley.

items.title: Saturation Mechanisms in the Interacting Dark Sector
items.efc_relevance: Introduces a half-saturation ‘sparseness scale’ in the dark-sector coupling that bounds energy exchange between DM and DE and prevents phantom-crossing. Conceptually parallel to EFC's K(ρ)-stiffness saturation in the L2→L3 transition; strong cousin of framework:CoupledDE-DM-Amendola2000 with a nonlinear saturation kernel.
items.ledger_action: Add as 2026 nonlinear coupled-DE/DM cousin to competitor-landscape table; required head-to-head with EFC saturation kernel in WP3 Falsification Protocol.

items.title: CLASH-VLT: The Fifth Force in Chameleon Gravity from Joint Lensing and Kinematics Cluster Mass Profiles
items.efc_relevance: First high-precision joint gravitational-lensing + kinematics test of chameleon-screened f(R) at Mpc cluster scales using nine CLASH/CLASH-VLT clusters — exactly the regime where EFC's L2→L3 transition predicts μ<1 while f(R)/chameleon predicts μ>1 (FA2 sign-level discriminator).
items.ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as cluster-scale fifth-force constraint; cross-reference framework:fR-Starobinsky2007 and FA2; required head-to-head with EFC L2/L3 μ-sign prediction in WP3 Falsification Protocol.

items.title: From Big Bang Nucleosynthesis to Late-Time Acceleration in f(Q,L_m) Gravity
items.efc_relevance: Non-metricity–matter coupled modified-gravity model spanning both BBN freeze-out and late-time acceleration with a single coupling — same dual-regime ambition as EFC's L1↔L3 spine. Direct competitor in the f(Q)/f(Q,L_m) family that EFC must outperform on combined BBN + DESI DR2 + Pantheon+ ΔAIC.
items.ledger_action: Add to WP3 competitor-landscape table; cross-reference arXiv:2604.19545 (BBN bound on generalised entropies) and arXiv:2604.21151 (f(Q,T) affine EoS); required BBN + late-time joint-fit row in competitor matrix.

items.title: Generalizing the CPL Parametrization through Dark Sector Interaction
items.efc_relevance: Extends CPL w(z) with explicit dark-sector interaction kernel — same family as framework:CoupledDE-DM-Amendola2000 and arXiv:2604.21671 saturation cousin. Maps onto EFC's L2→L3 effective w(z) but adds an exogenous Q-coupling that EFC derives endogenously from K(ρ)-stiffness gradients; the kernel functional form is the discriminator.
items.ledger_action: Add to competitor-landscape ΔAIC table; cross-reference framework:wCDM-CPL-Chevallier2001 and arXiv:2604.21671; required mapping between EFC entropic coupling and Q(φ,ρ) kernel in WP1 recovery-conditions table.

items.title: Kinematic Lensing Ratio (KiLeR): Reviving Weak Lensing Cosmography as a Geometric Dark Energy Probe
items.efc_relevance: Independent geometric-only DE probe combining shear ratios with kinematic intrinsic shapes; bypasses photo-z, intrinsic-alignment and baryonic systematics. Roman Space Telescope forecast: ~1.9× improvement on DESI DR2 BAO+CMB+SN evolving-DE constraint. Provides a clean future test of EFC's L2→L3 effective w(z) with negligible perturbation-sector contamination.
items.ledger_action: Add to Stage-IV Roadmap as Roman-era geometric-DE probe; mark new ledger row 'awaiting Roman first light'; cross-reference arXiv:2503.14738 (DESI DR2) and ESA:EuclidDR1-2026-10-21 as orthogonal geometric anchor.

items.title: The End of the First Act: Spectral Running, Interacting Dark Radiation, and the Hubble Tension in Light of ACT DR6 Data
items.efc_relevance: ACT DR6 reanalysis (Garny–Niedermann–Sloth) showing ΔN_eff bounds are highly sensitive to spectral-running (α_s, β_s) priors; confirms Hubble tension and demonstrates Interacting Dark Radiation remains viable. Bears directly on EFC L1 regime: any entropic-flow contribution that mimics extra radiation must respect the joint (α_s, β_s, ΔN_eff) bound updated here.
items.ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as L1-regime constraint; require explicit EFC L1 prediction for effective ΔN_eff conditional on (α_s, β_s) priors; cross-reference framework:EDE-Poulin2019 and arXiv:2604.19545 (BBN entropic bound).

items.title: Extended Universal Rotational Curve of Spiral Galaxies (Salucci, Bhatia, Schiavone, Haridasu)
items.efc_relevance: Salucci-team URC extended out to 2R_opt using SPARC HI rotation curves; double-normalised RCs collapse onto a single universal profile in the dark-matter-dominated outer disk regime where MOND, Verlinde-2016 and EFC predictions diverge most. Provides a clean baryon-aware target shape against which EFC's k=0.415 universality prediction (ledger_galaxy_rotation_curves_sparc) can be tested in the regime its sealed parameters were not fitted on.
items.ledger_action: Re-run EFC SPARC pipeline (seed=42, k=0.415 sealed) on the extended-URC double-normalised profile; add to Validation Ledger alongside arXiv:2411.13329 (BIG-SPARC); update gap theory-multicomponent-sparc-universality with extended-URC outer-disk row; required head-to-head ΔAIC vs framework:VerlindeEmergent-2016 and framework:MOND-Milgrom1983.

items.title: Measuring fσ8 and BAO scale in the Local Universe: a joint real and redshift space analysis from CosmicFlows-4++ (Franco, Courtois, Bernui)
items.efc_relevance: Joint real/redshift-space measurement of the growth-rate amplitude fσ8 and the BAO scale at z≈0 from the CosmicFlows-4++ peculiar-velocity catalog — independent of CMB-anchored σ8 priors. Local fσ8 ≈ 0.30–0.38 sits below the Planck-anchored ΛCDM prediction at z=0 and is directionally consistent with EFC's perturbation-sector prediction μ(a)<1 (FA2 sign-level discriminator). Adds a low-z growth anchor that is orthogonal to DES Y6 / KiDS Legacy / CMB-lensing arms of the S8 picture.
items.ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as low-z (z≈0) perturbation-sector probe; update gap ledger_perturbationsector_valley with peculiar-velocity-based fσ8 row; cross-reference framework:VerlindeEmergent-2016 and arXiv:2602.12238 (S8 review) for probe-split bookkeeping; required head-to-head μ-sign comparison against framework:fR-Starobinsky2007 (FA2).

items.title: Singularity softening and avoidance by the action of thermal radiation in a generalized entropic cosmology (Elizalde, Yurov, Timoshkin)
items.efc_relevance: Generalized entropic cosmology with logarithmic-EOS viscous dark fluid coupled to dark matter on a flat FLRW background; Hawking-radiation thermal terms soften or remove early-time singularities. Sits squarely in EFC's emergent-entropic-gravity heritage (alongside framework:Padmanabhan-2009 and framework:VerlindeEntropic-2010) and supplies a worked toy model where a single entropy-based fluid replaces both the singularity and an explicit DM/DE split — the same structural move EFC's S(r,t) field makes at L2/L3.
items.ledger_action: Log to External Research Ledger under cluster emergent-entropic-gravity; add a row to Gap Analysis (gap theory-entropic-singularity-avoidance) noting EFC's S(r,t) flow does not yet have a published singularity-softening derivation analogous to this one; cross-reference framework:Padmanabhan-2009 and framework:VerlindeEntropic-2010; required follow-up: derive the EFC analogue of their thermal-correction condition and compare to EFC's bounce-free L0 boundary.

items.title: A Master Equation for Screening in Luminal Horndeski Gravity (Sirera, Baker, Hallam, Naidoo)
items.efc_relevance: Derives the unapproximated second-order perturbation equations for luminal Horndeski theories in the α-basis and reduces them to a single master screening equation that recovers Vainshtein and Chameleon limits and identifies a new 'Phaedrus' regime where the screening radius scales linearly with source mass. Directly tightens the discriminator against framework:Horndeski-Deffayet2011 and framework:Galileon-Nicolis2009 — EFC's recovery condition in L2 must remain distinguishable from the Phaedrus-screening signature on cluster-scale lensing profiles.
items.ledger_action: Add to External Research Ledger under cluster scalar-tensor-horndeski; update framework:Horndeski-Deffayet2011 row with Phaedrus-regime discriminator note; required follow-up in Predictions Ledger: state explicit EFC prediction for the static spherically-symmetric scalar-field profile around a galaxy-cluster halo and compare numerically to the Phaedrus master-equation solution at r ∈ [0.1, 5] h^-1 Mpc.

items.title: Nearly universal CMB TT spectrum from pre-inflationary dynamics in a closed universe: KICI scenario, bouncing universe, and emergent universe (Huang)
items.efc_relevance: Phase-space analysis of pre-inflationary dynamics in a spatially closed universe shows that KICI (kinetic-initial-conditions-for-inflation), bouncing, and emergent-universe scenarios all produce essentially the same large-scale-suppressed CMB TT spectrum — i.e. CMB TT alone cannot distinguish them. Tightens the negative-result band for EFC's L0/L1 boundary: any EFC variant that posits a closed-universe pre-inflationary phase inherits the same CMB-TT degeneracy and must lean on lensing / non-Gaussianity / B-modes for discriminative power.
items.ledger_action: Log to External Research Ledger under cluster alternative-cosmology; add note to framework:Ekpyrotic-Khoury2001 and framework:CCC-Penrose2011 rows that CMB-TT-only fits cannot separate them from KICI under closed-universe priors; flag in Gap Analysis (gap predictions-l0boundary-cmb) that EFC's L0-boundary observable must be specified beyond CMB TT to remain discriminating.

items.title: Backreaction and the Role of Spatial Curvature in the Cosmic Neighborhood (Galoppo, Buchert, Mourier)
items.efc_relevance: First direct computation of spatially-averaged dynamical quantities in the local universe using Cosmicflows-4++ and a covariant scalar-averaging formalism out to ~300 Mpc/h. Average spatial curvature contributes ~10% of the local energy budget across all probed scales; kinematical backreaction stays ≤1%; convergence to global ΛCDM background is NOT seen within 300 Mpc/h. Provides empirical traction for any framework that treats local averaging as physically real (framework:Timescape-Wiltshire2007), and gives EFC a low-z anchor: EFC's S(r,t) entropy-flow predicts a non-zero domain-averaged curvature signature whose amplitude can be benchmarked directly against this measurement.
items.ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as a local-universe averaging probe; update framework:Timescape-Wiltshire2007 row with quantitative ~10%-curvature anchor; new gap row (gap theory-backreaction-localdomain-efc) — EFC currently has no published prediction for domain-averaged spatial curvature on 30–300 Mpc/h scales; required follow-up: compute EFC analogue of (Ω_R^D, Ω_Q^D) on the same Cosmicflows-4++ domains.

items.title: From Scalar H_0 to E(z): A Reformulation of the Hubble Tension (Lee)
items.efc_relevance: Re-expresses the Hubble tension in terms of the dimensionless expansion history E(z)=H(z)/H_0 instead of a single scalar H_0, separating the absolute-scale anchor (Pantheon+SH0ES) from the redshift-dependent shape (Planck CMB + DESI DR2 BAO). For EFC this is the natural framing: EFC predicts a specific E(z)-shape deviation from ΛCDM driven by the entropy-flow source term S(r,t), and a scalar-H_0 comparison hides exactly the redshift-dependent signature where EFC differs.
items.ledger_action: Add to Likelihood Ledger and Predictions Ledger as the canonical H_0-tension framing going forward; update P-series rows that currently quote a scalar H_0 to also publish EFC's predicted E(z) at z ∈ {0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0, 1.5}; cross-reference arXiv:2503.14738 (DESI DR2) and Pantheon+SH0ES anchors; deprecate scalar-H_0-only comparisons against framework:LCDM-Planck2018 in favour of E(z)-shape comparisons.
